speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you have had a fever and changes in your mental state for the last two days. To help me understand your condition, can you tell me your age and if you have any underlying medical conditions like diabetes or liver disease?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old male. The patient presents with a 2-day history of fever and altered mentation, reporting fever without chills and rigors. He denies sore throat, abdominal pain, headache, loose stool, burning micturition, or seizures. Has a history of tics and is currently taking haloperidol.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome (NMS) secondary to haloperidol use. Given the history of fever, altered mentation, and current antipsychotic medication, immediate supportive care and cessation of the offending agent are indicated. Please confirm if you have noticed muscle rigidity or tremors.
